hook.allele: In the first second a flat voice starts talking while one white caption locks onto the frame

hero.allele: The format itself: one on-screen text line plus one object held still for the punchline, no face and no named person

setting.allele: Tight vertical phone crop against a plain indoor wall, the held object centered

humor.allele: Deadpan assurance that nothing is hidden, then the held object is the whole joke

audio.allele: Deadpan spoken line, flat and unhurried: Why would I deceive you?

visual.allele: One caption line only, then the held object frozen on the punchline beat for the rest of the loop

structure.allele: 6–10s loop: deadpan line, one text line, then the held punchline. The black NOIR/05 bottle enters at second 4.0, on the held punchline beat after the deadpan line.
